# WHETHER EACH SHIPPED WIRE CARRIES A SESSION — `<wire key> <session | ->`, one row per linked wire
# ROW of the shipped fold (src/root/tests/fixtures/transport_fold.txt; a scheme an entry claims past
# its own, `sse`, is that entry's row). Read by tests/body_chunk_bounds.rs, which
# holds every linked wire's `SESSION` (its linked entry's export) to this row, and drives the frame
# ceiling on the `-` rows: a wire that carries no session is handed no session slot, so the run of
# "not yet" answers the ceiling counts does not exist on it. A wire that gains or loses a session has
# to say so here.
tcp session
http -
ws session
grpc session
stdio session
